entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Maroon Train slowly started to..."
entries.dialogueText: The Maroon Train slowly started to move.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Among camera flashes and cheers, we..."
entries.dialogueText: Among camera flashes and cheers, we departed from the Holsord central train station. Our destination was Perla, the capital of Lespia. The historic route we were using was also called The Southern Express.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "This train had been in service for..."
entries.dialogueText: This train had been in service for many years. It had nine locomotives with special quarters and an office. As the name implied, it was painted bright maroon.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Also, we need to be careful. I hea..."
entries.dialogueText: “Also, we need to be careful. I heard that he is a shrewd man.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We passed through the Lespian mount..."
entries.dialogueText: We passed through the Lespian mountain range to the lowlands, with a short stop at the beautiful Sarea Nueva where Lespian security forces joined us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Looking outside the window, the dif..."
entries.dialogueText: Looking outside the window, the difference in wealth between Valgen and Sarea Nueva was extraordinary.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“This happened just yesterday. Appa..."
entries.dialogueText: “This happened just yesterday. Apparently he was so drunk that he couldn't get off the plane on a diplomatic visit.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Is this something that could affec..."
entries.dialogueText: “Is this something that could affect this trade deal?”
entries.menuText: “Is this something that could affect this trade deal?”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“We are almost at Perla. I will ret..."
entries.dialogueText: “We are almost at Perla. I will return to my cabin now.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard a knock on the door to my o..."
entries.dialogueText: I heard a knock on the door to my office on the train and Symon entered.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'll see you when we arrive.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I'll see you when we arrive.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Although I knew that he was one of..."
entries.dialogueText: Although I knew that he was one of the youngest state leaders in the world, I was still surprised by how boyish he looked. At his age, he was leading one of the strongest countries in Eastern Merkopa.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Yes? What is it?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Yes? What is it?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Symon. Have a seat.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Symon. Have a seat.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I left the broken handle next to th..."
entries.dialogueText: I left the broken handle next to the teapot.
entries.menuText: Leave the broken handle next to the teapot.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gestured towards the two couches..."
entries.dialogueText: He gestured towards the two couches and we sat down face-to-face.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“I wanted to have a quick chat abou..."
entries.dialogueText: “I wanted to have a quick chat about Prime Minister Alvarez and give you a heads up.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He sat down on a chair in front of..."
entries.dialogueText: He sat down on a chair in front of my desk.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He was holding his head like he had..."
entries.dialogueText: He was holding his head like he had a headache and he was stumbling. Upon seeing me, he immediately composed himself. We shook hands.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“I do. I am sure we will be fine, M..."
entries.dialogueText: “I do. I am sure we will be fine, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Very well.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very well.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“There have been some rumours about..."
entries.dialogueText: “There have been some rumours about his...demeanour in public appearances.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The door opened and Patricio Alvare..."
entries.dialogueText: The door opened and Patricio Alvarez entered.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What do you mean? What did he do?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What do you mean? What did he do?”
entries.menuText: “What do you mean? What did he do?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Go on.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Go on.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I can handle him. Don't worry.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I can handle him. Don't worry.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“I am sure we will be fine, Mr. Pre..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am sure we will be fine, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The convoy came to a stop and I mad..."
entries.dialogueText: The convoy came to a stop and I made my way to the entrance. The assistants directed me to a room to wait for Prime Minister Alvarez.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few minutes later, with a long wh..."
entries.dialogueText: A few minutes later, with a long whistle, our train came to a stop. I waved to the crowd from the window.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“He is known to have met with other..."
entries.dialogueText: “He is known to have met with other state leaders while intoxicated on various occasions.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: BaseGameIsolated.Turn08_FPnT_BrokenTeapot = true

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Yellow House was situated at th..."
entries.dialogueText: The Yellow House was situated at the very centre of Perla in the middle of a circular park that was off limits to regular citizens. The park was full of roses on small patches.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I hid the broken handle behind the..."
entries.dialogueText: I hid the broken handle behind the plant next to the teapot cabinet.
entries.menuText: Hide it behind a nearby plant.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Some even call him an alcoholic.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Some even call him an alcoholic.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Now I am worried.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Now I am worried.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“So the man can't handle his drink...."
entries.dialogueText: “So the man can't handle his drink. Is that it?”
entries.menuText: “So the man can't handle his drink. Is that it?”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Although his premiership is riddle..."
entries.dialogueText: “Although his premiership is riddled with these kind of incidents, I also heard that he is a shrewd man.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Regardless, I don't think we shoul..."
entries.dialogueText: “Regardless, I don't think we should underestimate them. They hold substantial economic power, after all.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I put the broken handle in my pocke..."
entries.dialogueText: I put the broken handle in my pocket.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It should be fine. I have dealt wi..."
entries.dialogueText: “It should be fine. I have dealt with worse than that before.”
entries.menuText: “It should be fine. I have dealt with worse than that before.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Honestly, I don't know.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Honestly, I don't know.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I sat in the exquisite room and loo..."
entries.dialogueText: I sat in the exquisite room and looked up at the golden chandeliers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crowds of reporters that flocke..."
entries.dialogueText: The crowds of reporters that flocked over were pushed away by the Lespian security guards. We made our way to our cars and the convoy began its short trip to the Yellow House.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“That seems to be the case.”"
entries.dialogueText: “That seems to be the case.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I went back to my chair."
entries.dialogueText: I went back to my chair.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“I don't think there will be any is..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't think there will be any issues either. I just wanted to give you a heads up.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I started inspecting the teapot."
entries.dialogueText: I started inspecting the teapot.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thanks for giving me a heads up.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thanks for giving me a heads up.”
entries.menuText: “Thanks for giving me a heads up.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“After this incident, some say he i..."
entries.dialogueText: “After this incident, some say he is unfit to serve. But I don't believe that at all.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“I wouldn't bet on it.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I wouldn't bet on it.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“We need to be careful. I heard tha..."
entries.dialogueText: “We need to be careful. I heard that he is a shrewd man.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He handed me a newspaper. The headl..."
entries.dialogueText: He handed me a newspaper. The headline was 'Circling Over Staalport'.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After ten minutes. there was still..."
entries.dialogueText: After ten minutes. there was still no sign of Prime Minister Alvarez. It was almost time for our meeting.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "While I was touching it, the handle..."
entries.dialogueText: While I was touching it, the handle broke off. I looked around. Thankfully no one was in the room.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I hope he doesn't show up drunk to..."
entries.dialogueText: “I hope he doesn't show up drunk to our meeting too.”
entries.menuText: “I hope he doesn't show up drunk to our meeting too.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Why is that?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Why is that?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Trust me. I can handle him.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Trust me. I can handle him.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“These are the Lespians people fear..."
entries.dialogueText: “These are the Lespians people fear? Ridiculous.”
entries.menuText: “These are the Lespians people fear? Ridiculous.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My chair started to feel uncomforta..."
entries.dialogueText: My chair started to feel uncomfortable. I stood up and walked around to look at the various items in the room. A beautiful golden teapot piqued my interest.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I admired the teapot and left it al..."
entries.dialogueText: I admired the teapot and left it alone.
